kits.name: Valve, Counter-Strike 2
kits.description: The official music kit of Counter-Strike 2.

kits.name: Daniel Sadowski, Crimson Assault
kits.description: Video Game Composer Daniel Sadowski delivers Edgy Action mixed with CRAZY FAT beats in this pulsating, exhilarating Music Pack.

kits.name: Noisia, Sharpened
kits.description: Dutch Electronic Trio Noisia brings a tough, cinematic feel with a unique blend of tradition and progression.

kits.name: Robert Allaire, Insurgency
kits.description: Music to crush your enemies see them driven before you from award winning composer Robert Allaire.

kits.name: Sean Murray, A*D*8
kits.description: From the composer of two of the world's biggest war games, comes a sonic loadout that will bring your enemies to Hell's Gate!!

kits.name: Feed Me, High Noon
kits.description: Renowned elecronic musician Feed Me, brings a western corral showdown into a modern electronic space.

kits.name: Dren, Death's Head Demolition
kits.description: From game music composer Dren, this cinematic, superhero-metal inspired music pack puts the 'ill' into KILL!

kits.name: Austin Wintory, Desert Fire
kits.description: Grammy nominated game composer Austin Wintory asks, why bother hunting your enemies when you can lure them in with a deadly, admittedly insane, tango?

kits.name: Sasha, LNOE
kits.description: Immerse yourself in this cinematic soundtrack full of soaring strings, pulsating melodies and driving drums from the world renowned DJ / Producer Sasha

kits.name: Skog, Metal
kits.description: A lesson in aggression from Metal producer, Skog.

kits.name: Midnight Riders, All I Want for Christmas
kits.description:
"HAPPY HOLIDAYS, ****ERS!"
    -Midnight Riders

kits.name: Matt Lange, IsoRhythm
kits.description: Indulge your aural senses in a collection of cinematic, glitchy atmospheres and hard-hitting throbbing rhythms by electronic producer and innovator Matt Lange.

kits.name: Mateo Messina, For No Mankind
kits.description: Own your enemies. Pure intensity by Grammy winning composer, Mateo Messina.

kits.name: Various Artists, Hotline Miami
kits.description: A multitude of electronic artists deliver brutal beats in this exhilarating Music Pack from the iconic Hotline Miami.

kits.name: Daniel Sadowski, Total Domination
kits.description: Composer Daniel Sadowski raises the bar with aggressive electronic beats, creative sound fx and an exhilerating, driving, futuristic vibe. "Warning: Will cause a rise in adrenaline!"

kits.name: Damjan Mravunac, The Talos Principle
kits.description: Composer Damjan Mravunac blends energetic cinematic grooves with epic choirs in this music pack featuring music from Croteam's critically acclaimed title "The Talos Principle".

kits.name: Proxy, Battlepack
kits.description: Russian Heavy Electronica Artist PROXY brings his own Unique heavy artillery to Counter Strike. Hybrid audio Weaponry fused with the finest studio technology makes this pack unique.

kits.name: Ki:Theory, MOLOTOV
kits.description: Recording artist and DOTA TI4 performer, Ki:Theory drops BOMBS with this searing set of razor edge dark electronic rock.

kits.name: Troels Folmann, Uber Blasto Phone
kits.description: Triumphant Blastophones combine with contemporary Uberpulse in this explosive collection by ultra award winning composer Troels Folmann.

kits.name: Kelly Bailey, Hazardous Environments
kits.description: Kelly Bailey, composer of Valve's Half-Life series, creates an arsenal of apocalyptic new music inspired by the darker side of the Half-Life universe.

kits.name: Skog, II-Headshot
kits.description: Metal composer and producer Jocke Skog returns with an all new, hard hitting metal kit, turning the rest of the CS:GO Music Kits into something cute, warm and fuzzy. Now go become MVP so everyone can hear your awesomeness!

kits.name: Daniel Sadowski, The 8-Bit Kit
kits.description: Daniel Sadowski creates the first ever 8-bit Music Kit for Counter-Strike complete with authentic 8-bit sounds.

kits.name: AWOLNATION, I Am
kits.description: AWOLNATION Alternative Rocker AWOLNATION brings you a music kit for the ages. This kit is jam-packed with an eclectic selection of tunes and includes cuts from singles 'I Am' and multi-platinum hit 'Sail'.

kits.name: Mord Fustang, Diamonds
kits.description: Diamonds. They are forever. Dive into the arpeggiotron of Mord Fustang with this fresh set of grooves and atmospheres.

kits.name: Michael Bross, Invasion!
kits.description: Michael Bross conjures epic / cinematic techno-grunge to make you feel like a true badass in battle.

kits.name: Ian Hultquist, Lion's Mouth
kits.description: Mixing pulsating strings and synths with pounding war drums, prepare yourself for battle with this thunderous soundtrack from composer Ian Hultquist.

kits.name: New Beat Fund, Sponge Fingerz
kits.description: Sunny surf rock with elements of hip-hop, punk and garage pop. Keep it real and get headshots.

kits.name: Beartooth, Disgusting
kits.description: Beartooth brings an agressive back-to-basics hardcore stomp that gets crowds moving and breaking stuff. A perfect soundtrack for your no-scope scout frags. Rock 'till you're dead.

kits.name: Lennie Moore, Java Havana Funkaloo
kits.description: Game Composer Lennie Moore serves an aromatic, spicy blend of Jazzy Funk. Delicious when served cold, like the corpses of your enemies after you're done with them.

kits.name: Darude, Moments CSGO
kits.description: Yield freely in the soundscapes of Finnish producer Darude's familiar musical flavours and tones. Enriching yourself with access to a heavy fusion of progressive overtones and scores of tingling melodic structure from the sounds banks of one of dance music's most renowned pioneers.

kits.name: Beartooth, Aggressive
kits.description: Beartooth is back for round two. This new music kit hits harder and is even more aggressive. We've also made the MVP anthem extra heavy so your opponents feel really bad after they've lost to you.

kits.name: Blitz Kids, The Good Youth
kits.description: British Pop/Punk band Blitz Kids brings you the perfect music kit for rushing B while thinking about those night drives you had with your friends in High School. This kit is for going fast and feeling young.

kits.name: Hundredth, FREE
kits.description: Hundredth is bringing heavy to the world with their unique take on melodic hardcore. Break free or return to Dust with this perfect soundtrack for fragging the unworthy.

kits.name: Neck Deep, Life's Not Out To Get You
kits.description: Sometimes you just need some Pop Punk to get you through the day. Whether it is dealing with campers or losing a massive kill streak, Neck Deep is here to prove that Life's Not Out To Get You, but the other team still is.

kits.name: Roam, Backbone
kits.description: Roam delivers fast, straight-forward Pop Punk that gets crowd and players alike moving. Prove you have a Backbone with this perfect soundtrack for rushing in and obliterating the other team before they even realize they're deadweight.

kits.name: Twin Atlantic, GLA
kits.description: Heavier, rowdier, and louder than ever, Twin Atlantic comes to CS:GO ready to help you melt the faces with the firepower of Scottish rock.

kits.name: Skog, III-Arena
kits.description: Skog is back with a third crushing metal kit. This time with an electro-organic twist to the music, combining massive guitar riffs with equally massive drops, loop elements and drones.

kits.name: The Verkkars, EZ4ENCE
kits.description: The Verkkars rise through the Finnish charts with a heart-pounding tribute to ENCE. Can it really be so EZ?

kits.name: Halo, The Master Chief Collection
kits.description: Give your Counter Strike auditory experience a legendary makeover with the Master Chief Collection Music Pack, featuring iconic musical moments from the Halo universe. © 2019 343 Industries. All rights reserved. Used with permission from 343 Industries. Halo: The Master Chief Collection and the Halo logo are trademarks of the Microsoft group of companies.

kits.name: Scarlxrd: King, Scar
kits.description: Scarlxrd blends heavy trap beats with a flow and delivery that creates his own unique subgenre. With this exciting blend his live shows capture the attention of everyone in the crowd.

kits.name: Half-Life: Alyx, Anti-Citizen
kits.description: This music kit commemorates Half-Life: Alyx, Valve's VR return to the Half-Life series. You are humanity's only chance for survival, and your immersive environmental interactions continue in Counter-Strike: Global Offensive.

kits.name: Austin Wintory, Bachram
kits.description: Austin Wintory mixes Celtic fantasy with sizzling electronics and a generous helping of Peter Hollens' vocals in this genre-bending Music Kit.

kits.name: Dren, Gunman Taco Truck
kits.description: The apocalyptic mariachi soundtrack from the indie game hit, Gunman Taco Truck, comes to CS:GO with intense Mexican flavored tunes like Pollo Diablo and Persecución de Helltain!

kits.name: Daniel Sadowski, Eye of the Dragon
kits.description: From the composer who brought you "Total Domination", "The 8-Bit Kit" and "Crimson Assault", comes "Eye Of The Dragon". Music composer Daniel Sadowski mixes Ninjas + Guns + Hip-Hop + Techno to create an action-packed Music Kit. Ninjas are known for their fast and precise attacks, yet they can be invisible to their enemy.

kits.name: Tree Adams and Ben Bromfield, M.U.D.D. FORCE
kits.description: Alchemists of a powerful chaos that is M.U.D.D. FORCE - composers Tree Adams and Ben Bromfield weld epic battle motifs and grinding synths into a Maelstrom of full throttle destruction.

kits.name: Tim Huling, Neo Noir
kits.description: Composer Tim Huling delivers classic film-noir style tracks blended with contemporary grooves and beats.

kits.name: Sam Marshall, Bodacious
kits.description: Inspired by the funky video game music of the early 90s, composer Sam Marshall cooks up some classic game nostalgia with a spicy modern sauce.

kits.name: Matt Levine, Drifter
kits.description: Composer Matt Levine delivers raw swagger in this gritty homage to the Spaghetti Western. It has never felt better to say, "go ahead, make my day..."

kits.name: Amon Tobin, All for Dust
kits.description: Legendary producer Amon Tobin lends his unique aesthetic to CS:GO. This time through tube amplifiers.

kits.name: Darren Korb, Hades Music Kit
kits.description: Sure, you might miss a shot from time to time, but what never misses is this blood-pumping Music Kit straight from the Underworld of Hades, Supergiant's rogue-like dungeon crawler.

kits.name: Neck Deep, The Lowlife Pack
kits.description: Prove you are not a normie (and better than everyone else on the map) with Neck Deep's new music kit, which includes songs from the band's album All Distortions Are Intentional.

kits.name: Scarlxrd, CHAIN$AW.LXADXUT.
kits.description: CHAIN$AW BRINGS SCARLXRD AT HIS UNPRECENDENTED BEST WITH A RAW FLOW AND A HEAVY TRACK TO MATCH.

kits.name: Austin Wintory, Mocha Petal
kits.description: Austin Wintory answers the question humanity has asked for ages: what happens if you merge beer garden accordion polka music with grungy heavy metal?

kits.name: Chipzel, ~Yellow Magic~
kits.description: Video game composer and chiptune legend Chipzel brings a glitchy Speak & Spell inspired mashup of hybrid styles packed with fun, funk and flavour.

kits.name: Freaky DNA, Vici
kits.description: Opera. 8-bit sounds. Analogue synths. What's not to love? Chiptune specialist Freaky DNA and soprano Leanne Koch team up for some heavy beats and good times!

kits.name: Jesse Harlin, Astro Bellum
kits.description: Composer Jesse Harlin delivers bombastic space opera drama inspired by classic sci-fi of the 70s, 80s, and beyond.

kits.name: Laura Shigihara: Work Hard, Play Hard
kits.description: Video game composer and developer Laura Shigihara will help you tell everyone loudly and proudly that you're the MVP. Have fun with this unique blend of 90s dance, retro video game synth, and just a hint of Plants vs. Zombies.

kits.name: Sarah Schachner, KOLIBRI
kits.description: Brought to you by Sarah Schachner, a dystopian goth choir of self-aware, Scandinavian robots decide that humanity must be eliminated.

kits.name: bbno$, u mad!
kits.description: bbno$ formulates 'the' toxic gamer anthem, u mad! Are u mad? LOL get good scrub. Research shows if you play with this Music Kit equipped you'll immediately go from Silver to Global.

kits.name: The Verkkars & n0thing, Flashbang Dance
kits.description: From sunny California to frigid Lapland, Counter-Strike legend n0thing and The Verkkars combine powers to create the smash hit, Flashbang Dance! 3, 2, 1 you’re blind!

kits.name: 3kliksphilip, Heading for the Source
kits.description: On a quest to go pro, or unintentionally going low? Let this kit’s 80’s synths and dreamy melodies take you back. Back, back, back... to the good old days.

kits.name: Humanity's Last Breath, Void
kits.description: Swedish Band Humanity's Last Breath drops in heavy with their Void Music Kit. Pounding drums, colossal riffs and an atmosphere to send shivers up your spine.

kits.name: Juelz, Shooters
kits.description: Neo trap synths, gritty 808s, an epic piano riff, and a plethora of gunfire sound effects. The OG trap anthem "Shooters" by Juelz makes for a truly elite Music Kit. Suitable for MVPs only.

kits.name: Knock2, dashstar*
kits.description: dashstar*, the iconic bass house anthem from Knock2, provides non-stop energy that captures the young San Diego native’s mantra, "no limit".

kits.name: Meechy Darko, Gothic Luxury
kits.description: Grab a Glock and equip this music kit to be transported to the center of New York's underground hip-hop scene.

kits.name: Sullivan King, Lock Me Up
kits.description: Love the chase? Love the hunt? Hard rock, metal, and dubstep collide in Sullivan King's soundtrack for becoming unstoppable.

kits.name: Perfect World, 花脸 Hua Lian (Painted Face)
kits.description: Celebrate the 5th anniversary of CS:GO's release in China with a one of a kind music kit, 花脸 Hua Lian (Painted Face). This kit combines folk Qinqiang opera (the earliest Chinese style Rock 'n' Roll) and modern Rock 'n' Roll. Whether you are engulfed in smoke or blinded by a flashbang, don't get lost!

kits.name: Denzel Curry, ULTIMATE
kits.description: Denzel brings his signature energy to CS:GO as he traverses trap, jazz, and drum and bass beats. This kit features Denzel's hits "Walkin", "ULTIMATE", and more, so break out the nickel-plated chrome Berettas and crank up the intensity with the ULTIMATE music kit.

kits.name: Valve, CS:GO
kits.description: The default CS:GO music kit, introduced with the launch of CS:GO in 2012.

kits.name: DRYDEN, Feel The Power
kits.description: What else needs to be said? Feel The Power. Lock in with this high-energy electro Music Kit from DRYDEN.

kits.name: ISOxo, inhuman
kits.description: Made especially for those games when you feel... different. Haunt your enemies round after round with the "inhuman" Music Kit from ISOxo.

kits.name: KILL SCRIPT, All Night
kits.description: Are you a lover or a fighter? Perhaps both? Let the entire lobby know with the "All Night" Music Kit from KILL SCRIPT.

kits.name: Knock2, Make U SWEAT!
kits.description: For players who treat every game like it's a Major Grand Final, even when there's only a few hundred CSR on the line. Bring the energy and the wins with Knock2's second Music Kit, "Make U SWEAT!".

kits.name: Rad Cat, Reason
kits.description: Sometimes defusing the bomb is enough to be the round MVP. Celebrate every moment—big or small—with the "Reason" Music Kit from Rad Cat.

kits.name: TWERL and Ekko & Sidetrack, Under Bright Lights
kits.description: There's no better time to come alive than when in the spotlight. Let the drum and bass anthem "Under Bright Lights" by TWERL and Ekko & Sidetrack carry you and your team to new heights.

kits.name: Austin Wintory, The Devil Went Clubbing in Georgia
kits.description: Austin Wintory makes a deal with Satan, smashing together devilish fiddle music with full-on EDM club vibes.

kits.name: Ben Bromfield, Rabbit Hole
kits.description: You've been double-crossed! Experience this high-stakes, broodingly tense, jazz-inspired soundtrack from film & TV composer Ben Bromfield as you uncover just how deep this rabbit hole goes...

kits.name: Daniel Sadowski, Dead Shot
kits.description: Daniel Sadowski invites players to enter the world of "Dead Shot", a hybrid blend of action, hip-hop, orchestral, electronic, retro, emotion, and sound design. Avoid the Head Rot!

kits.name: Dren McDonald, Coffee! Kofe! Kahveh!
kits.description: Caffeine is your friend. It's everybody's friend, except for your enemy! "Coffee! Kofe! Kahveh!" is BalkanBalkanBalkan! street party brass music from Dren Mcdonald ("Gunman Taco Truck" and "Death’s Head Demolition") recorded live in Balkancisco!

kits.name: Matt Levine, Agency
kits.description: Enter the dangerous world of espionage with the "Agency" music kit from composer Matt Levine.

kits.name: Sam Marshall, Clutch
kits.description: "Clutch", the unsanctioned sequel to "Bodacious", is a cyber-funk, fever dream abomination reanimated by Sam Marshall through alchemy and arcane ritual.

kits.name: Tim Huling, Devil's Paintbrush
kits.description: Get your adrenaline up with "Devil's Paintbrush" from Tim Huling, a high-energy groove-metal experience.

kits.name: Tree Adams, Seventh Moon
kits.description: Here on "Seventh Moon", Tree Adams rolls up a greasy mix of intergalactic funk with a driving battle score.

kits.name: Perfect World, Ay Hey
kits.description: Merging traditional Chinese folk and electronic music, "Ay Hey" offers vivid storytelling and energetic beats to connect players of different ages and backgrounds. With its lively rhythm matching players' enthusiasm for the game, "Ay Hey" vividly captures various humorous and playful battle scenes.

kits.name: Adam Beyer, Red Room
kits.description: Swedish techno legend Adam Beyer brings you this dreamy belter of a music kit to help paint your enemies red.

kits.name: Ghost, Skeletá
kits.description: MESSAGE FROM THE CLERGY—Papa V Perpetua has descended on Counter-Strike in a glorious heavy metal spectacle. Escape the travails of daily life as you spray and pray to the Unholy See.

kits.name: HEALTH, RAT WARS
kits.description: Experience HEALTH in Counter-Strike. Take up arms and enjoy the brutal and punishing industrial metal sound of RAT WARS.

kits.name: James and the Cold Gun, Chewing Glass
kits.description: Welsh rock duo James and the Cold Gun unleash pure, unfiltered energy, blending classic punk attitude with modern alt-rock fire to create a blistering music kit.

kits.name: Jonathan Young, Starship Velociraptor
kits.description: Space-Pirate Power Metal is what your game is missing. Take a ride on the Starship Velociraptor and let the sounds of Jonathan Young's anime and video game inspired album bring your matches to another level.

kits.name: Juelz, Floorspace
kits.description: Need Floorspace? This massive music kit from Juelz’s debut album contains neo-rave synths, gritty bass lines, and hard hitting trap drums. Floorspace has been reimagined for Counter-Strike 2, and the MVP anthem “Gossip” makes players want to set up—then drop—an LED wall.

kits.name: Killer Mike, MICHAEL
kits.description: Enjoy the 3x GRAMMY Award winning hip-hop album in the world of Counter-Strike. Killer Mike's voice will help keep you motivated as you rise through the ranks and improve your skills.

kits.name: PVRIS, Evergreen
kits.description: The only thing we love more than a good enemy? A good soundtrack. Let the new PVRIS music kit hype up your team and keep your victory streak Evergreen.

kits.name: Selective Response, No Love Only Pleasure
kits.description: Drive your desires with this dynamic, high-energy music kit from American techno icon Selective Response. Charged up and ready for action.

kits.name: Tigercub, The Perfume of Decay
kits.description: UK rock outfit Tigercub delivers a gritty melodic punch, fusing raw alt-rock intensity with a brooding modern edge to create a crushing music kit.

kits.name: ALRT, DOPAMINE HIT
kits.description: ALRT's bouncy bass house record delivers the ultimate "DOPAMINE HIT", keeping you locked in and ready to rise to the occasion when it matters most.

kits.name: Altare, Change My Mind
kits.description: Altare's euphoric wave anthem "Change My Mind" is perfect for the highest of highs when it feels like nobody can stand in your way.

kits.name: borne, Give It To Me
kits.description: borne's gritty bass banger "Give It To Me" will have players ready to give it to their opponents in Counter-Strike, and beyond.

kits.name: Pirapus, EVERYNITE
kits.description: Pirapus' high octane drum and bass anthem "EVERYNITE" evokes the feeling of being on the edge of greatness. True to its name, this one ensures you're locked in every night.

kits.name: Repiet & Julia Kleijn, On And On
kits.description: Be prepared for any challenge with Repiet and Julia Kleijn's infectious track "On And On." Through the highs and the lows, it's a tune that sets the tone to attack any obstacle.

kits.name: ShockOne, Voices
kits.description: Break free with ShockOne's high energy drum and bass record "Voices." Primed for delivering in the clutch, this music kit features punchy bass lines that will carry you to many MVPs.

kits.name: Starjunk 95, Industrial Sunset Memories
kits.description: Experience a music kit from the grooviest station in the galaxy, featuring the newest sounds of today drenched with vintage nostalgia of yesterday. This is Starjunk 95.
